changes.reason: Apply the response no-cache directive to ISR cache writes, stored responses and requests sharing an initial cache fill.

kubernetes.reason: The existing Node ISR composition applies the same Fetch response policy before returning a response.
constraints: Cross-process durable caching still requires Redis or another durable store. Existing no-cache entries are bypassed until TTL expiry.
Local HTTP and adapter tests do not verify a Kubernetes deployment.

aws-lambda.reason: The existing Lambda composition uses the same ISR response policy before serializing the invocation response.
constraints: Durable caching still requires a reachable store with caller-managed connection lifetime.
Local handler tests do not verify a deployed Lambda or live Redis.

cloudflare.reason: The Workers composition uses the same Fetch response policy without a new binding or Node dependency.
constraints: Durable caching still requires a Worker-safe store. The in-memory store is isolate-local.
Local handler tests do not verify a deployed Worker or a durable Worker store.
